correction: Two beliefs were wrong. (1) Sunshine's Trixie release asset name was stable: v2026.906.222525 renamed sunshine-debian-trixie-amd64.deb to sunshine_<VER>-1+debiantrixie_amd64.deb, so the workflow's hardcoded template 404'd and 'Update sysext checksums' aborted the whole run (a plain URL fix would have produced an update PR whose sysext build then failed at dpkg -i). (2) An upstream deb's Depends field reflects what its binary links: Sunshine's CPack Depends still names libqt5widgets5, libqt5svg5 from the Qt5 branch of TRAY_QT_VERSION while the binary links only Qt6 (plus libXtst); the old GTK3/appindicator/libnotify deps are gone. dpkg enforces Depends regardless, so the sysext must either carry ~35 MB of dead Qt5 or strip the pair from the control file before install. Also: qt6-qpa-plugins/qt6-wayland are only Recommends of libqt6gui6, which mkosi never installs, yet QGuiApplication aborts without a platform plugin -- Recommends of a GUI toolkit can be hard requirements for a sysext.
evidence: Run 34236035250 job 102093871849: 'curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 404' after the sunshine step. Upstream cmake/packaging/linux.cmake at the tag appends 'libqt5widgets5, libqt5svg5' when TRAY_QT_VERSION != 6; the 2026-09-07 prereleases carry the same Depends. Trixie Packages: libqt6gui6 Recommends qt6-qpa-plugins, qt6-svg-plugins, qt6-wayland; libqt5widgets5 exists only as a Provides of libqt5widgets5t64.
